events.detail: signed but structurally invalid catalog was rejected

events.name: malformed-package
events.detail: catalog-bound bytes with an invalid bundle were rejected

events.name: command-conflict
events.detail: second command was refused by the evidence ownership lock

events.name: atomic-rollback
events.detail: interrupted activation recovered the verified previous copy

events.name: launch-failure

events.name: owner-data-preservation
